industryApplication.tagline: AI Agents that detect confusion and intervene before a student falls behind.

children.text: Traditional education scaling struggles with 'The 2 Sigma Problem'—providing 1:1 tutoring quality at scale. Students often watch lectures passively, retaining little, and gaps in foundational knowledge compound over time, leading to disengagement and failure.
Zeta Academy employs a multi-agent AI architecture using The Oracle™ and Mission Logic™.
The Oracle™ analyzes student interactions (quiz answers, chat queries, dwell time) in real-time, identifying specific misconceptions.

Mission Logic™ dynamically adjusts the curriculum, inserting 'Review Missions' or unlocking 'Advanced Operations' based on demonstrated mastery, ensuring the cadet is always in the Zone of Proximal Development.

keyCapabilities: The Oracle™ provides instant clarification and 'Explain Like I'm 5' breakdowns of complex topics.
Mission Logic™ gamifies the remediation process, turning 'homework' into 'Special Operations'.
expectedResults: Agents that adapt continuously to student learning velocity.
Zeta Academy ensures no cadet is left behind by catching gaps instantly.
